sourceText: 我记得好像是10分钟并没有真正切断，而是会“进入后台”，我们的当前目录下的claude的session有发生过这种事情，你检查一下是不是这样。如果是这样，我们需要更稳健地处理，不是只有确定性知道是卡死才应该重启，否则应该持续监控codex的进展，而不是到了10分钟就重启
normalizedOutcome: Long-running Codex or Claude agents remain monitored on the same task identity beyond ten minutes; elapsed time alone never triggers replacement, and one replacement is allowed only after an authoritative terminal or missing/dead signal.
acceptanceClaim: All active Lattice agent guidance is status-first and background-aware, while explicit bounded subprocess timeout enforcement remains unchanged.
